name: cropped headline next to a dim stat card
looks: A short bold headline sits large and left-cropped, its last letters pushed off the edge of the frame, on a near-black ground. To the right, a small label and a low number sit over a flat, barely-moving line chart, dim and understated, like a stat nobody is proud of. A HUD-style corner frame and a bottom caption mark this as the first beat of a sequence.
build: A DOM headline is set oversized so its trailing letters clip past the safe frame, on a static or barely-panning camera. The stat card is a DOM number set from the clock with no easing (the live-readout-hud mechanic), with a thin SVG polyline for the flat chart. The corner brackets and captions are the film's constant HUD frame layer.
sound: A flat, quiet tone under the stat card, a single soft thud as the headline settles.
prompt: Open on a short, bold claim set so large its last letters bleed off the edge of the frame, and beside it a small, deliberately unimpressive stat card (a low number over a flat line chart) that the rest of the film will beat. Keep the stat quiet and dim, a problem to be solved, not a win.
